title: A neural network you can train

stops.caption: A real neural network, training now
stops.detail: Every card is a neuron, drawn as what it responds to. Lines are weights: thick is strong, orange is positive. The big field is what it believes everywhere.
points: Drag on the field to add points
Click a neuron to remove it, a + to add one
Train, data, inputs and layers are below

stops.caption: What it believes, and what it learns from
stops.detail: Orange dots mean it thinks orange; bigger means surer. The round dots are the data. Drop your own and watch the boundary bend to fit them.

stops.caption: The weights, changing as it learns
stops.detail: Each line is one weight. Training thickens the ones that help and thins the rest.

summary: A small multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation, live in the page.
